editorial:
You thought you left the hitman life behind, but your past has other plans. In Mechanic: Resurrection, Arthur Bishop is pulled back into action when a ruthless enemy kidnaps his girlfriend Gina. To get her back, he must pull off three impossible kills across the globe and make each one look like an accident. Jason Statham brings his usual tough-guy charm, and the movie moves fast from one exotic location to the next.

The action is big, loud, and full of wild stunts, like a prison break and a poolside explosion. Jessica Alba adds heart as Gina, while Tommy Lee Jones shows up for a fun cameo. The story is simple and sometimes silly, but it never slows down. If you want a brain-off action night, this delivers. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final act, Bishop fakes his own death and teams up with arms dealer Max Adams to take down Crain. He storms Crain's yacht, rescues Gina, and kills Crain in a brutal fight. With the enemy gone, Bishop and Gina sail away together, finally free from his past. The last shot shows them at peace on the open water, hinting that Bishop's killing days are truly over.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves high-octane action and Jason Statham movies.
